Frontend Developer Roadmap 2025:

1. FOUNDATIONS (0-3 months): HTML5 semantics, CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, animations), JavaScript ES6+ (async/await, modules, destructuring). Build 5+ static pages.

2. REACT ECOSYSTEM (3-6 months): React 18+ (hooks, context, Suspense), TypeScript, state management (Zustand/Redux Toolkit), React Router, fetching (TanStack Query). Build 3 full projects.

3. STYLING (ongoing): Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, Framer Motion for animations. Master responsive design and dark mode.

4. BUILD TOOLS: Vite, Webpack basics, ESLint, Prettier. Understand module bundling.

5. TESTING: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress for E2E. Aim for 80%+ coverage.

6. ADVANCED (6-12 months): Next.js (SSR, SSG, App Router), performance optimization (lazy loading, code splitting, Web Vitals), accessibility (WCAG 2.1), PWA basics.

7. DEPLOYMENT: Vercel, Netlify, Docker basics, CI/CD with GitHub Actions.

Key skills employers look for: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, testing, performance optimization.

Salary range (India): 4-8 LPA fresher, 8-18 LPA mid, 18-40+ LPA senior.

Backend Developer Roadmap 2025:

1. LANGUAGE MASTERY: Pick Python (FastAPI/Django) or Node.js (Express/NestJS). Learn async programming, error handling, module patterns.

2. DATABASES: PostgreSQL (relational), MongoDB (NoSQL), Redis (caching). Learn SQL deeply — joins, indexes, query optimization. ORMs: SQLAlchemy/Prisma.

3. API DESIGN: REST (best practices, status codes, pagination), GraphQL basics, WebSocket for real-time. API versioning, rate limiting.

4. AUTHENTICATION: JWT, OAuth 2.0, session management, password hashing (bcrypt), role-based access control.

5. INFRASTRUCTURE: Docker, Docker Compose, basics of Kubernetes. CI/CD pipelines. AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) or GCP.

6. ADVANCED: Message queues (RabbitMQ, Redis Pub/Sub, Kafka basics), microservices patterns, caching strategies, background jobs (Celery, BullMQ).

7. MONITORING: Logging (structured logs), monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana), error tracking (Sentry).

Key skills: Python/Node.js, SQL, Docker, REST APIs, authentication, cloud deployment.

Salary range (India): 5-10 LPA fresher, 10-25 LPA mid, 25-50+ LPA senior.

Full Stack Developer Roadmap 2025:

Combines Frontend + Backend skills with emphasis on end-to-end ownership.

1. FRONTEND: React/Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, state management.
2. BACKEND: Node.js (Express/NestJS) or Python (FastAPI/Django), REST APIs, GraphQL.
3. DATABASE: PostgreSQL + Redis. Know when to use SQL vs NoSQL.
4. DEVOPS: Docker, CI/CD, Vercel/Railway deployment, basic AWS.
5. FULL STACK FRAMEWORKS: Next.js (preferred), T3 Stack, Remix.

Full Stack advantage: You can build entire products solo. This is extremely valuable for startups.

Project ideas: SaaS dashboard, e-commerce platform, real-time chat app, job board with AI features.

Salary range (India): 6-12 LPA fresher, 12-30 LPA mid, 30-60+ LPA senior.

DevOps Engineer Roadmap 2025:

1. LINUX: Command line mastery, shell scripting (Bash), file permissions, process management, networking basics.

2. CONTAINERS: Docker (Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, Compose), Kubernetes (pods, services, deployments, Helm charts).

3. CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI. Build automated pipelines for testing, building, deploying.

4. CLOUD: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS, EKS) or GCP or Azure. Learn IaC with Terraform.

5. MONITORING: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, alerting. SLA/SLO management.

6. SECURITY: Network security, secrets management (Vault), vulnerability scanning, RBAC.

7. ADVANCED: GitOps (ArgoCD), service mesh (Istio), chaos engineering, cost optimization.

Salary range (India): 6-12 LPA fresher, 12-30 LPA mid, 30-55+ LPA senior.

ML Engineer Roadmap 2025:

1. MATH: Linear algebra, calculus, probability, statistics. Khan Academy or 3Blue1Brown.

2. PYTHON: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn. Master data manipulation.

3. ML FUNDAMENTALS: Supervised learning (regression, classification, trees, SVM), unsupervised (clustering, PCA), evaluation metrics, cross-validation.

4. DEEP LEARNING: PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow. CNNs, RNNs, Transformers. Fine-tuning pre-trained models.

5. NLP & LLMs: Hugging Face Transformers, BERT, GPT, RAG systems, LangChain, vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone). Prompt engineering.

6. MLOPS: Experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B), model serving (FastAPI, TorchServe), containerization, A/B testing.

7. ADVANCED: Reinforcement learning, GANs, diffusion models, multi-modal models.

Hot areas 2025: LLM fine-tuning, RAG applications, AI agents, computer vision.

Salary range (India): 8-15 LPA fresher, 15-35 LPA mid, 35-80+ LPA senior.

Data Scientist Roadmap 2025:

1. STATISTICS: Hypothesis testing, A/B testing, Bayesian statistics, regression analysis.

2. PYTHON: Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Statsmodels, Scikit-learn.

3. VISUALIZATION: Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, Streamlit for dashboards.

4. SQL: Advanced queries, window functions, CTEs, query optimization.

5. ML MODELS: Classification, regression, clustering, ensemble methods, time series forecasting.

6. BIG DATA: PySpark, Databricks, Airflow for data pipelines.

7. COMMUNICATION: Storytelling with data, business acumen, presenting to stakeholders.

Key difference from ML Engineer: Data Scientists focus more on insights and business impact, ML Engineers focus more on production systems.

Salary range (India): 6-12 LPA fresher, 12-28 LPA mid, 28-55+ LPA senior.

Android Developer Roadmap 2025:

1. KOTLIN: Modern Kotlin (coroutines, flows, sealed classes). Java basics.

2. JETPACK COMPOSE: Modern UI toolkit (composables, state, navigation, theming). Replace XML layouts.

3. ARCHITECTURE: MVVM, Clean Architecture, Repository pattern, dependency injection (Hilt/Koin).

4. NETWORKING: Retrofit, OkHttp, Ktor. REST API consumption, Kotlin Serialization.

5. LOCAL DATA: Room database, DataStore, SharedPreferences.

6. TESTING: JUnit, Espresso, Compose testing, MockK.

7. ADVANCED: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), WorkManager, Firebase integration, CI/CD.

Salary range (India): 4-8 LPA fresher, 8-20 LPA mid, 20-40+ LPA senior.

Cloud Architect Roadmap 2025:

1. FOUNDATION: Networking (VPC, subnets, load balancers), compute (EC2, Lambda), storage (S3, EBS).

2. AWS SERVICES: RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, CloudFront, Route53, IAM.

3. ARCHITECTURE: Microservices, event-driven, serverless, multi-region.

4. INFRASTRUCTURE AS CODE: Terraform (preferred), CloudFormation, Pulumi.

5. CONTAINERS: ECS, EKS, Fargate.

6. SECURITY: IAM policies, encryption, compliance frameworks, WAF.

7. CERTIFICATIONS: AWS Solutions Architect Associate → Professional.

Salary range (India): 10-18 LPA junior, 18-40 LPA mid, 40-80+ LPA senior.

Cybersecurity Engineer Roadmap 2025:

1. NETWORKING: TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, VPNs, Wireshark.

2. LINUX: Command line, file permissions, process management, log analysis.

3. SECURITY BASICS: OWASP Top 10, encryption, hashing, PKI, TLS/SSL.

4. TOOLS: Nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nessus, SIEM tools.

5. DEFENSIVE: Incident response, forensics, SOC operations, threat hunting.

6. OFFENSIVE: Penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, social engineering.

7. CERTIFICATIONS: CompTIA Security+, CEH, OSCP, CISSP.

Salary range (India): 5-10 LPA fresher, 10-25 LPA mid, 25-50+ LPA senior.

UI/UX Designer Roadmap 2025:

1. UX FOUNDATIONS: User research, personas, user flows, information architecture, wireframing.

2. UI DESIGN: Visual design principles (typography, color theory, spacing, grid systems), component libraries.

3. TOOLS: Figma (essential), Adobe XD, Sketch. Prototyping and handoff.

4. DESIGN SYSTEMS: Building and maintaining design systems, tokens, accessibility.

5. PROTOTYPING: Interactive prototypes, micro-interactions, animation principles.

6. USER TESTING: Usability testing, A/B testing, analytics interpretation.

7. ADVANCED: Design for AI products, voice interfaces, AR/VR, motion design.

Portfolio is CRITICAL. Build 3-5 case studies showing your design process.

Salary range (India): 4-8 LPA fresher, 8-20 LPA mid, 20-40+ LPA senior.

Product Manager Roadmap 2025:

1. FUNDAMENTALS: Product thinking, market research, competitive analysis, user personas.

2. FRAMEWORKS: Jobs-to-be-done, RICE prioritization, MoSCoW, OKRs, product-market fit.

3. ANALYTICS: Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics. Data-driven decision making.

4. TECHNICAL: Understand engineering basics (APIs, databases, deployment). You don't code but you must communicate with engineers.

5. COMMUNICATION: PRDs, user stories, stakeholder management, roadmap presentation.

6. GROWTH: A/B testing, funnel optimization, retention strategies.

7. AI PRODUCTS: Understanding LLMs, prompt engineering, AI product design patterns.

Salary range (India): 8-15 LPA fresher, 15-35 LPA mid, 35-60+ LPA senior.

QA Engineer Roadmap 2025:

1. MANUAL TESTING: Test case design, boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, exploratory testing.

2. AUTOMATION: Selenium, Cypress, Playwright. Page Object Model pattern.

3. API TESTING: Postman, REST Assured, contract testing.

4. PERFORMANCE: JMeter, k6, load testing, stress testing.

5. CI/CD INTEGRATION: Running tests in pipelines, parallel execution, reporting.

6. MOBILE TESTING: Appium, XCTest, Espresso.

7. SHIFT-LEFT: TDD, BDD (Cucumber), testing in development phase.

Salary range (India): 3-7 LPA fresher, 7-18 LPA mid, 18-35+ LPA senior.

Interview Preparation Tips:

1. RESUME: Keep it 1 page (fresher) or 2 pages (experienced). Use action verbs. Quantify achievements (increased X by Y%). ATS-friendly format.

2. DSA: Practice LeetCode/Codeforces. Focus on arrays, strings, trees, graphs, DP. 150+ problems minimum. Use Neetcode 150 roadmap.

3. SYSTEM DESIGN: Study Netflix, Uber, Twitter architectures. Learn CAP theorem, database sharding, caching, message queues. Practice on Excalidraw.

4. BEHAVIORAL: Use STAR format. Prepare 5 stories (conflict, failure, leadership, challenge, teamwork). Practice with a friend.

5. PROJECTS: Have 2-3 strong projects. Know every line of code. Be ready to explain tech choices, trade-offs, and challenges.

6. COMPANY RESEARCH: Know the company's product, tech stack, recent news, and competitors.

7. COMMUNICATION: Think aloud during coding rounds. Ask clarifying questions. Be honest about what you don't know.

Resume Writing Guide:

1. FORMAT: Clean, single-column, ATS-friendly. No fancy graphics. Use a modern template (Jake's Resume, Deedy).

2. SECTIONS (in order): Contact info, Summary (2 lines), Skills, Experience, Projects, Education, Certifications.

3. SKILLS: List specific technologies, not vague terms. 'React, TypeScript, Node.js' NOT 'proficient in web technologies'.

4. EXPERIENCE: Use action verb + what you did + impact. 'Built RESTful API serving 10K req/min using FastAPI and Redis caching, reducing latency by 40%'.

5. PROJECTS: Include GitHub links. Describe the tech stack, your role, and impact. Open source contributions stand out.

6. COMMON MISTAKES: Typos, generic objective statements, listing duties instead of achievements, lying about skills, too long.

7. TAILORING: Customize resume for each role. Match keywords from the job description.

Career Advice for Freshers:

1. DON'T CHASE PACKAGES: Focus on learning, not salary. Your first job is about growth.

2. BUILD IN PUBLIC: GitHub contributions, blog posts, Twitter/LinkedIn content. This builds your brand.

3. NETWORKING: Attend meetups, hackathons, conferences. Most jobs come through referrals.

4. FREELANCING: Upwork/Fiverr projects give real experience and build your portfolio.

5. OPEN SOURCE: Contributing to open source is the fastest way to level up. Start with 'good first issue' labels.

6. STARTUP vs MNC: Startups = faster growth, broader skills, more risk. MNC = structured learning, stability, brand value. Choose based on your risk appetite.

7. CONTINUOUS LEARNING: Tech changes fast. Dedicate 1 hour daily to learning. Follow industry blogs, YouTube channels, newsletters.

Salary Negotiation Guide:

1. RESEARCH: Use Glassdoor, Levels.fyi, LinkedIn Salary to know market rates.

2. TIMING: Never share your current salary first. Ask for the budget range.

3. MULTIPLE OFFERS: The best negotiation leverage. Apply to multiple companies.

4. TOTAL COMPENSATION: Salary + ESOP + bonus + benefits. Evaluate the full package.

5. COUNTER OFFER: Always counter the first offer. Be specific and justified.

6. WALK AWAY: Know your minimum. Don't accept below your worth.

7. REMOTE PREMIUM: Remote roles often pay less in India but save commute costs. Factor this in.
